import networkx as nx

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(11))
for i in range(11):
    G.add_edge(i, (i + 1) % 11)
    G.add_edge(i, (i + 2) % 11)

print(nx.node_connectivity(G))
edges = list(G.edges())
edges = [list(e) for e in edges]
for e in edges:
    e.sort()
edges.sort()
print(edges)
